hypothese.text:
== THESIS SUMMARY ==
Near-monopoly in assisted tax preparation (TurboTax) and dominant SMB accounting franchise (QuickBooks), with Credit Karma and Mailchimp as growth adjacencies. The central bet: the 'guidance moat' (software that walks the user step by step, creating behavioral lock-in and high margins) survives the market's generative-AI disruption fear - a fear priced brutally (stock down >50% from the 814 peak). FY26 (ended 31/07) guided at 23.80-23.85 non-GAAP EPS; the report (~21/08/2026) is imminent.

== THESIS READ ==
- The AI threat is priced as existential while the franchises still compound double-digit - the asymmetry IS the thesis. Watch: the FY26 print and FY27 guide (~21/08) - first hard verdict.
- Agentic-AI features are Intuit's own offense (done-for-you finance), monetizable across the installed base. Watch: AI attach/pricing disclosures at the report.
- Credit Karma re-accelerated and Mailchimp stabilized in recent quarters - the adjacencies stopped detracting. Watch: segment splits at FY26.

== SPECIAL FACTORS ==
Fiscal year ends JULY - the FY26 report (~21/08) closes the measurable year, rolls the horizon, and must initialize dernierCall (absent from this pre-close refresh). Base = GAAP with SBC and acquisition amortization KEPT (structural ~7-8/share wedge vs the non-GAAP guide, documented in the scorecard). FY26 restructuring excluded from the normalized base as a true one-off.

== PARAMETERS & WATCH-LIST ==
FY26: revenue 21.4bn (+13.4%), EBIT 6.04bn (Omnium base), net 4.52bn / EPS 16.68; FY27-FY30: revenue +12%/yr, margin drift, ETR 24% normative (FY25 actual ~20% documented), shares -2.5%/yr degressive. finNet ~-88M improving. Watch: FY26 report (imminent); TurboTax Live share of tax revenue; any AI-driven pricing pressure evidence.

== CATALYSTS ==
FY26 results + FY27 guidance (~21/08/2026 - days away); tax-season 2027 early indicators; AI feature monetization; buyback pace at depressed prices.

ancrages.mechanism: Revenue growth anchored on the raised formal FY26 guidance (13-14%), then convergence towards the FY27 sell-side consensus (~12%, 23.9 Mds$) and a gradual deceleration towards ~10%/yr at the end of the horizon
EBIT margin expansion driven by the restructuring and the AI efficiency gains already visible in FY25 (+390bp), at a tapering pace absent any communicated LT target
FY26 restructuring charge (300-340M$ guided, 320M$ retained) treated as a genuine one-off and added back into omniumEBIT/omniumNet FY26
Normative tax rate maintained at 24% (management FY26 guidance), rolled forward unchanged
Buyback pace accelerated by the new 8Mds$ authorisation (May 2026) and the depressed share price, diluted share count reduction ~2.5%/yr on a tapering basis
SBC and amortisation of acquisition intangibles kept as genuine recurring expenses (not adjusted out, unlike management's non-GAAP)
